# Rooms

<a name="walkable-zones"></a>

## Walkable zones

The hero walks inside the zones. A zone ends at [a door](create.exits.md#doors); every command is in [the DSL](create.dsl.md).
The save is written by [save.ts](../../src/engine/core/save.ts#L1).

> [!LIMIT id=no-diagonal]
> A zone is a polygon; a curve is drawn with several points.
